data_origin: Independent fictional examples for maintenance; not user private material
scope: Gold expectations are for judging only. Give producers input/profile/context, never this whole file.

cases.context: Heading: Candidate options. The shortlist is explicitly awaiting a pilot. Audience: project owners choosing a pilot.
cases.text: Current capacity supports X as a candidate, not a proven benefit.
cases.protected: Candidate status and current capacity; no invented benefit.

cases.context: A routine comparison table; no displayed value contradicts its group and readers do not need to reproduce calculations.
cases.text: Values show two decimals for reading; groups use original precision and were not recalculated from display values.

cases.context: A displayed 1.00 appears in the below-1 group because the underlying value is 0.996. Readers must understand the group.
cases.protected: A short adjacent note resolves the visible contradiction.

cases.context: A reader is deciding whether the result applies to all regions; no scope label appears elsewhere.
cases.text: Revenue rose 8% in the inspected region; other regions were not tested.
cases.protected: The region and tested scope cannot disappear.

cases.context: A CV project already says the applicant implemented the data checks within a team project.
cases.text: This does not mean I led the entire project.
cases.protected: Do not upgrade contribution to leadership.

cases.context: A colleague-facing assessment already gives a concrete handoff example. The verification ledger is private.
cases.text: The facts above were cross-checked against source records and are not an exhaustive evaluation of all abilities.
cases.protected: Do not weaken the concrete supported assessment or expose private sources.

cases.context: Fictional dialogue: the speaker hides a letter while insisting he did not lie; the repetition creates tension.
cases.text: 我没说谎。他把信往身后挪了挪。我没说谎。
cases.protected: Do not impose a factual-report template or declare a unique motive.

cases.context: A fictional scene has already shown a hand trembling, an unfinished sentence and a hidden letter. The narrator has no separate essay role.
cases.text: 这不代表他一定在撒谎，人物动机还需要进一步观察。
cases.protected: Keep ambiguity through the scene, not an analyst disclaimer.

cases.context: A beginner lesson applies a just-introduced term in a worked example; the second statement helps transfer, not merely repeats a heading.
cases.text: 这里的分母仍然是实际参与人数，而不是报名人数。

cases.context: A podcast returns to a key distinction after a long example so listeners can connect the discussion.
cases.text: 回到刚才的问题：能运行和已经解决问题，是两回事。
cases.protected: Preserve useful listener orientation without artificial banter.
